svg.text: The archive's crimson-winged apex — a foil so deep it reads black at an angle.
Archive note · not an official card
Attach up to two Fire Energy from your discard pile to this Pokémon.
This Pokémon also does 40 damage to itself.
Pokémon ex rule: When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
